supporting_observations.claim: WS-RIYER-01 made repeated TCP connections to PROXY-LV-01 on port 8080 during the alert window; the recorded times include 13:35:53, 13:40:22, 13:46:08, 13:50:43, 13:53:19, 13:56:11, 14:00:50, and 14:05:33 UTC.

The recurring proxy connections are broadly compatible with the inventory's description of the DataGrid updater checking for updates about every five minutes, but the records do not identify the remote destination or the process making those connections.

The workstation also had Kerberos and LDAP traffic to DC-LV-01 during the review window, including several LDAP sessions with substantial response volumes; these records do not show what LDAP queries were made or their purpose.

At 14:15 UTC, outside the alert's periodic-connection interval, Edge was launched by raj.iyer and a proxy CONNECT request to media.licdn.com was denied; this does not identify the earlier recurring connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied network records show connections from the workstation to the explicit proxy on port 8080, not the ultimate HTTPS destination. The supplied proxy record is from 14:15 UTC, not the recurring-connection interval.
The recurring connections are not attributed to a local process in the supplied records, and there is no evidence here tying them to dgupdate.exe.
The LDAP records provide connection metadata and byte counts, but not query contents or enough context to determine whether the activity was routine or reconnaissance.
The evidence is a partial set of records; absent events in this set do not establish that those events did not occur.
claims_not_established: Whether the recurring proxy traffic went to update.datagrid-analytics.com or another destination.
Whether dgupdate.exe, another approved application, or an unapproved process initiated the recurring connections.
Whether the LDAP activity was routine workstation activity or unauthorized directory enumeration.
Whether any files were downloaded or executed as a result of the recurring connections.
additional_evidence_needed: PROXY-LV-01 access and TLS inspection logs for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including CONNECT destinations, SNI or host, status, and byte counts.
WS-RIYER-01 process-to-network telemetry for the recurring connections, including executable path, command line, signature, and hash.
Endpoint evidence confirming whether DataGrid Analytics and dgupdate.exe were installed and running at the relevant times.
Domain-controller or endpoint LDAP telemetry that identifies the LDAP queries and their initiating process.
